candidate.title: DR-Seq
candidate.scope: The middle DR-Seq row of the assigned Illumina poster: same-cell gDNA/mRNA co-amplification followed by a physical split and separately completed transcript and genome libraries. The Dey et al. implementation (PMID 25599178) resolves the broad branch captions. Adjacent Duplex-Seq and G&T-seq rows and the right-hand chemical drawing are context, not alternatives within this row. MALBAC-like amplification is a component correspondence, not an additional target method. No unshown adaptation, integrated analysis operation or complete experimental recipe is asserted.
